classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding cable lengths and vertical heights in nested similar triangles.

content.prompt:
Two cables support a pole at the same angle, as shown.
The two cables are $4\,\mathrm{m}$ and $10\,\mathrm{m}$ in length. The shorter cable reaches $3\,\mathrm{m}$ up the pole.
Find the height of the pole.

spec.description: Nested right triangles on the left of a vertical pole, with separate ground attachments and matching dot angle markers. The outer cable reaches the top and the inner cable reaches the lower attachment. Ordinary source blue lines and pale purple pole are reconstructed in black without decorative fill.
spec.mathematics: The corresponding hypotenuses are 10 m and 4 m; the smaller vertical height is 3 m. The ground angles are equal. Construction coordinates preserve that equality and are not printed givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the cable lengths and lower attachment height are visible; the pole height remains unknown.

answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the pole's height. Corresponding heights and cable lengths are proportional.
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{h}{3}&=\frac{10}{4}\\h&=3\times\frac{10}{4}\\h&=7.5\,\mathrm{m}\end{aligned}$$
